about: Recorded, reviewed acceptances of vendor revisions to bars already stored in scripts/backtestData/. Read by scripts/fetchBacktestData.mjs; matched by matchRecordedRevisions in scripts/lib/recordedRevisions.mjs. A row adopts the vendor's bar only for a VOLUME revision of that ticker and date whose signed relative change lies inside the row's band (at most 0.05 wide, excluding 0), only while the fixture on disk is the version the reviewer saw (fixtureFetchedAt), and only before the row's expires date. Adopting rewrites the fixture with a new fetchedAt, so going forward a row fires once per fixture version; restoring the old fixture would let it fire again until it expires. No vendor values: dates, fields and signed relative bounds only (design invariant I8). Rows are added by pull request with a data-integrity review; main has no required reviews (design invariant I7), so that is a convention, not a control. Checked by __tests__/data/acceptedRevisions.test.ts.

rows.reason: Policy decision, not a finding about which figure is correct: for a volume-only revision of a bar whose open, high, low and close are unchanged, follow the vendor's current figure rather than freeze the instrument. Disclosed contrary evidence: the revision (+21.84%) is CAT's alone, about 60x the largest move among the 54 other equities' same-day volumes between the same two vintages; and the same vendor's intraday bars summed over the session fit the stored figure better than the revised one (daily-to-intraday ratio z = 2.9 for the stored figure, 6.8 for the revised one). A late-reported block print would explain the revision; the data neither confirms nor refutes it. Materiality: nil for the benchmark today (a 2026-10-09 bar cannot yet enter a 20-day label); the stored figure stays in git history. To reverse before adoption: delete this row. After adoption: revert that run's change to scripts/backtestData/CAT.json AND delete this row; CAT then returns to quarantine, because the vendor still disagrees.
rows.evidence: refresh-data.yml run 39178415183 (2026-10-18) quarantined CAT on this bar; reviews/q144-data-integrity-regate-2026-10-18.md, finding Q144-R2-1 (null: 605 tail-bar volume revisions, p99 3.9e-3); reviews/q144-exit-path-data-integrity-2026-10-24.md, finding E-3 and section 3 (cross-section and intraday comparison).
